meta.title: UDP-Pattern global model — UCP shopping
meta.analog: UDP-DT uses TM Forum SID Customer as global meaning; UDP-Pattern uses UCP shopping.

concepts.name: Product
concepts.description: UCP Product — Global ID (GID) uniquely identifying a sellable product (title, description, url, categories, price_range, variants).

concepts.name: Variant
concepts.description: UCP Variant — purchasable SKU of a Product. GID is used as item.id in checkout; sku and barcodes correlate across marketplaces.

concepts.name: LineItem
concepts.description: UCP Line Item — item (Variant GID) + quantity + totals on a Cart or Checkout.

concepts.name: Cart
concepts.description: UCP Cart — pre-checkout basket with line_items, currency, and estimated totals.

concepts.name: Checkout
concepts.description: UCP Checkout session — native checkout on Google AI surfaces (create / update / complete). Status lifecycle incomplete → completed.

concepts.name: Order
concepts.description: UCP Order — post-purchase record bound to checkout_id, line_items, fulfillment, and totals (GMV source).

concepts.name: Fulfillment
concepts.description: UCP Fulfillment — buyer expectations and what actually shipped (methods, destinations, events).

concepts.name: Buyer
concepts.description: UCP Buyer — first_name, last_name, email, phone. Guest checkout default; identity linking optional.

concepts.name: PaymentHandler
concepts.description: UCP Payment Handler — processor (e.g. Google Pay) separate from the buyer instrument.

concepts.name: MerchantProfile
concepts.description: UCP profile published at /.well-known/ucp — services, capabilities (checkout, fulfillment, discount, order), and payment handlers.

concepts.name: Attribution
concepts.description: UCP Attribution — platform-emitted campaign, click, and source/medium context on Cart/Checkout.

overlay.name: Brand
overlay.note: seller / metadata — not a second identity
